fusions.name: Hoofbeat Shriek
fusions.desc: You drum your hooves and shriek across a 4-tile cone, dealing 12 damage and stunning everything caught for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Swoop
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A swooping kick at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dark of the Moon
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 28% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Winded Thirst
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
